item.title: Teen kills 4 at Oregon school. And, DOJ sues California over alleged noncitizens
item.description: A teen opened fire at an Oregon elementary school, leaving three kids and one teacher dead. And, the Justice Department is suing California over alleged noncitizen voters.

item.title: 3 children, teacher killed in shooting at Oregon elementary school
item.description: Three children and a teacher were killed in a shooting at a Bend, Oregon, elementary school Thursday. Officials say a bystander confronted and fatally shot the 16-year-old suspected shooter.
item.content:encoded: Three children and a teacher were killed in a shooting at a Bend, Oregon, elementary school Thursday. Officials say a bystander confronted and fatally shot the 16-year-old suspected shooter.

item.title: U.S. historic preservation law faces the most serious threat in its 60-year history
item.description: Congress and a federal agency are threatening to weaken the country's historic preservation law, fueling a backlash that critics say is as fiery as the one that led to the law's creation 60 years ago.

item.title: LA fire survivors face another setback with FEMA program delays
item.description: The fight over a FEMA program aiding some of LA's most vulnerable wildfire victims is the latest setback for hundreds of fire survivors who still haven't rebuilt after the deadly 2025 infernos.
